messages: It seems #p503#, the master weaponcrafter of #m10004000#, is finally ready to acknowledge my weaponcrafting skills.
#p503#, the master weapon craftsman of #m10004000#, was amazed by my growth and suggested that I show off my skills. I need to defeat #r#o24#s#k and craft #b1 #t1422003##k to bring back to him.

#p503#, the master weapon craftsman of #m10004000#, was impressed by my craftsmanship and handed me a #t4130000#. It looks like a special item that can change an equipment's stats when used during crafting. Maybe I should try it out.
name: A Weaponcrafter in My Own Right!
